wins.text: Total revenue grew 30% YoY to $726M in Q3, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by ~450 bps; U.S. business grew 44% YoY
U.S. commercial revenue grew 54% YoY and 13% sequentially to $179M; U.S. commercial customer count grew 77% YoY to 321 customers
Adjusted operating margin expanded to 38%, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of margin expansion; Rule of 40 score reached 68
Adjusted free cash flow of $435M in Q3 (60% margin); first time ever generating over $1B in trailing 12-month adjusted FCF
Q3 TCV booked of $1.1B, up 33% YoY and 16% sequentially; U.S. commercial TCV of $297M; net dollar retention improved 400 bps to 118%

risks.text: International commercial revenue grew only 3% YoY and declined 7% sequentially to $138M due to continued headwinds in Europe and a step-down in revenue from a government-sponsored enterprise in the Middle East
Strategic commercial contracts revenue expected to decline to $6M–$7.5M in Q4 2024 vs. $20M in Q4 2023, representing a meaningful YoY headwind
International government revenue declined 5% sequentially to $89M due to less favorable deal timing and Q2 revenue catch-up effects
Stock-based compensation acceleration risk flagged: company may be required to accelerate SBC expenses if market-based vesting criteria are achieved earlier than expected due to rising stock price
Expenses expected to ramp through Q4 as company continues to invest in technical talent and product pipeline, creating near-term margin pressure risk

guidance_items.detail: Full year 2024 revenue raised to $2.805B–$2.809B (midpoint $2.807B), representing ~26% YoY growth; Q4 2024 revenue guided to $767M–$771M
U.S. commercial revenue guidance raised to in excess of $687M for full year 2024, representing at least 50% growth
Adjusted income from operations raised to $1.054B–$1.058B for full year 2024; Q4 adjusted operating income guided to $298M–$302M (~39% margin)
Adjusted free cash flow guidance raised to in excess of $1B for full year 2024
Company continues to expect GAAP operating income and net income in each quarter of 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Defense tech partnership strategy and why primes/startups are now actively advertising Palantir logos and seeking partnerships (competitive dynamic shift)
Boot camp-to-deal conversion speed and whether the pace of customer conversion has surprised even management
Strategic commercial contracts wind-down and exposure to distressed equity-as-payment customers (e.g., Lilium)
